title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress' - BBC
description: Sotheby's says it will work with the heirs of a family who had previously owned the artwork to try and reach a solution.

title: Trump, Putin and Xi Jinping expected to meet in first-ever trilateral of its kind, officials say - CBS News
description: President Trump is looking to talk about reducing nuclear arsenals in the first formal trilateral between the leaders of the U.S., China and Russia.

title: Alaska voters stick with ranked-choice voting, again - Politico
description: The president has railed against the system, which has helped Democrats compete in the red state.

title: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors - CNBC
description: Two Nvidia investors with about $2.13 billion of stock disclosed as of June 30 are calling for a deliberate leadership search after Huang’s resignation.
